components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:20px;padding:0 24px;background:var(--ink,#00384C);font-family:Noto Sans Thai,sans-serif;font-size:14px}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:24px 0;color:var(--white,#FFFFFF);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a:active,.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--cyan,#44E0F8)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{font-weight:700}.ds-nav a[aria-current]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:15px;height:3px;background:var(--cyan,#44E0F8)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan,#44E0F8);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The system pairs confident Thai product communication with calm, task-oriented reading. The user-selected MoneyThunder homepage supplies the campaign grammar; Kiangjai's original identity, App imagery and reviewed content remain the visual and product authority.

A complete original App screen sits on a crisp layered stage. Strong cyan and ink chapters create the homepage rhythm; support and policy pages use restrained document layouts. These are native, editable HTML/CSS surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: One integrated product campaign with meaningful functional graphics.
Original brand assets and complete App screenshots.
Strong chapter contrast with quiet reading areas.
Natural Thai typography and visible keyboard states.

rules.name: The Chapter Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use cyan and ink to establish purposeful chapters; keep reading areas open and neutral.

rules.name: The Thai Integrity Rule
rules.body: Preserve natural Thai wrapping and zero letter spacing; the amount's numeric tracking does not apply to Thai text.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve depth for the complete product stage and dialogs; do not scatter floating ornaments through reading content.

dos: Do use the original master Logo and complete App images at their natural ratio.
Do keep the campaign integrated and functional illustrations subordinate to product truth.
Do preserve Thai wrapping, keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use reading layouts for safety and policy content.
donts: Don't introduce people photos, coins, gradients, giant decorative logos or fake App screens.
Don't crop a phone into half-screen decoration or split its background through the device.
Don't invent financial claims, approval evidence, store links, payment QR codes or legal resources.
